product_one_liner.value: Owl provides AI-powered claims intelligence that reads insurance claim files, extracts evidence-backed insights, and answers claims questions for insurance carriers and their claims teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes AI for insurance and reading claim files; the claims-intelligence page positions it as a platform for claims teams.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer lists company, product, solutions and resources links but no pricing link; there is no public pricing page listed.

named_customers.notes: The available case-study material refers to an unnamed carrier rather than identifying a customer; no two customers are publicly named on the cited pages.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 91 employees (updated October 30, 2026), which falls in the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists Vancouver, British Columbia as the headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists 2019 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The resource index contains educational, product and insurance-industry content, but does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The site navigation/footer has no public documentation or help-center link; it lists product, resources, company and security pages.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers board lists open product and engineering roles focused on AI-powered products and scalable AI platform architecture.

model_provider.notes: The product page discusses a custom vision-language model and compares it with GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4.6, but does not say that Owl uses either provider. The security page also does not identify a model provider or subprocessors.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the named compliance standards/certifications on the security page; GDPR is described as handling rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: The November 3, 2021 announcement reports $30 million in Series B funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round located was announced in November 2021, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers board lists an Enterprise Account Executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable resource and press indexes show recent articles and media coverage, but no product or major-feature launch announcement in the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership roster is listed on the about page, and the readable press index contains no announcement of a C-level or VP-level joining or departure during the preceding 12 months.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Enterprise Account Executive job listing explicitly names Salesforce for forecasting and CRM hygiene.
